newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.590 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.590 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.590 percent, up from the previous issue's 1.302 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on July 31, raised 859.1 million Swiss francs and was priced at 98.418 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on July 24, raised 1,001.60 million and was priced at 99.672 percent.
